svg.aria-label: A profile leaning at 45 degrees to its spine, swept along it (OCCT's test AGT003): at each corner of the spine OCCT's solid has two faces filling in between the sweeps of the two sides, which kentron's lacks.
svg.text: A profile swept along a spine
area 1539.57: no faces fill in at the corners;
in red, where OCCT's join the walls
area 1573.58: two faces at each corner fill in
between what is left of the sides' sweeps
